title: Sydney New Year’s Eve — City of Sydney official event guide

facts.fact: The City of Sydney advertises fireworks at 9pm and midnight; viewing arrangements must be checked by location rather than assuming all harbour access is identical.
facts.excerpt: Fireworks light the harbour at 9pm and midnight.
